'''Fogh the Tireless''' was a historical general.

== History ==
[[Gareth Bryne]] quotes Fogh, saying that "if you do not learn from your losses you will be ruled by them," and claims that this is a saying among generals.{{ref/book|14|21}}

==Trivia==
*Fogh is named after Alexander Fogh Pedersen, a fan of ''The Wheel of Time''.<ref name="thirteenth-depository">Taglieri, Linda. [http://13depository.blogspot.com/2002/02/character-names-derived-from-readers.html Character Names Derived From Readers' Names]</ref>
